name: pikud-alerts-suite
description: Pikud HaOref alert workflow — agent, skill, and SessionStart hook bundled. Fetches Israeli Home Front Command alerts and produces bilingual Markdown reports under reports/.

default_region.title: Default region filter
default_region.description: Hebrew substring applied to area names when /alert-report is called with no region argument. Leave empty to mean 'no filter — show all areas'. Example: מנרה (matches קיבוץ מנרה), חוף (matches any beach area).
